Curated view of [`canonical.md`](./canonical.md) — **priced rows only** (12 of 13 priced models that returned a real *final estimated price*), value-sorted (Findings desc, then Bench cost asc). Bench columns are ONE fixed-capability `locations` review against the **29-rule** catalogue, held constant — only model performance/cost varies. **Free rpm/rpd** = free-tier rate limit by tier; **Wall (s)** = `Bench req (s)` + rate-limit back-off; **Back-off %** = back-off ÷ wall. Generated by `join.py` (do not hand-edit).

> **Excluded** (priced but no real estimate): `microsoft/mai-ds-r1` — returned `unknown_model` / errored, so cost is a 0-token `$0.0000`.
> **Read `Bench cost` with `Findings`**: a low cost from a low-findings model means it under-reviewed, not that it's good value. **Back-off %** isolates the free-tier rate-limit tax from the model's own latency.
